mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, method, enabled, use_platform_config, config_json, created_at, updated_at FROM login_method_config WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY method
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO login_method_config (tenant_id, method, enabled, use_platform_config, config_json) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{method}, #{enabled}, #{usePlatformConfig}, #{configJson})
mapper.update: UPDATE login_method_config SET enabled = #{enabled}, use_platform_config = #{usePlatformConfig}, config_json = #{configJson}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND method = #{method}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM login_method_config WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND method = #{method}
